notes.title: First Avoidvania patch update!
notes.content:
Hi! 
Thank you very much for your feedback on this first version of Avoidvania Early Access! With this feedback we were able to re-adjust some mechanics and input and here is our first patch update of the game. Achievements have been re-integrated into the game, if you make a new game it is not impossible that you unlock many achievements based on your past and current game ...

Additions :
[list]
[*] Change of the controller input for the interaction and the Dash! You can now dash with X input on Xbox controller or Square on PlayStation controller
[*] Playstation controllers support
[*] Visual improvement of VoidPalace with more traps
[*] Added Fame indication in different menus
[/list]

Fixed bug:
[list]
[*] Steam achievements are back online!
[*] Controls on the option menu
[*] Bap-Bap quests fixed
[*] Quitting on PC was blocking the game
[*] Maintains the race even when releasing the race trigger on controller
[*] Delete save could get stuck
[*] Minor level corrections
[*] Lost dash after falling while restarting the level
[/list]
